_evidence: 0x0043ad30 indexes the 64-byte slot tables with [0x6097f0] and [0x6097f4] ('cmp byte [ebx+0x63bcfc],2; jne', 'movzx esi,byte [ebx+0x63bd3c]'): 0x43acb6 stores a slot index in each (ebx, then the loop counter ecx of the 0x63bd7c slot records), so both are 0..63 independently (equal in some cases); fuzzed dwords read far outside the tables and faulted 63/208. Bytes 0x63bcfc[k] are the slot states (0x424cf5 writes 2 = in use, 0x422833 clears): mostly 2 with 0/1 so both 'jne' outcomes occur. Bytes 0x63bd3c[k] are the slot's car number (0x424cf5 copies the car byte +0x202), 0..21: esi = 0x66fef0 + k*0x41c is a real car record. Byte +0xe5 of the 22 cars ('test byte [esi+0xe5],1; jne') draws bit 0 both ways; that car is then passed to 0x40f6d0 as esi, whose accepted domain (car_004129fa) has the car position dwords +0/+4 in -0x4000000..0x3fff7ff (i16 record frame <<11, so the walks stay in records 0..14): those are varied for all 22 cars in that range.
